title: Manager - Projects
description:
Sonepar Group (€33.3 billion ) is an independent family-owned company with global market leadership in B-to-B distribution of electrical products, solutions and related services.

Sonepar in India, Formerly known as ESK India was founded in 2009, a Leader in B2B Electrical Distribution of electrical equipment, technical services, and related solutions for Telecom, Industrial Automation, Integrated Supply, Networking Solution, Renewable Energy, Lighting, Power Distribution, Cabling Solution, Safety Tools, and Engineering Supplies primarily focused on Industrial & Commercial markets. Keeping Customers at the heart of our business approach, we understand their unique needs and design perfect solutions in achieving our goal to be a customer-centric organization.

Over the years we have built an extensive network of trusted partners who support us in offering a comprehensive line of innovative and durable products which are backed by our powerful logistics, comprising of numerous warehouses and offices Pan India. Our product specialists & engineers provide an exemplary experience to our customers by offering them a wide range of products with competitive prices, training, and customized solutions. We are proud to be certified as **“Great Place To Work”** which makes us the **“Employer of Choice”** for Candidates across various Industries.

JOB PURPOSE
  
This position supports the Project Execution Department in India and is responsible for
  
ensuring smooth execution of project billing, documentation, and site administration
  
activities. The role involves managing and reconciling all internal and external invoices,
  
maintaining commercial and technical documentation throughout the project lifecycle,
  
and ensuring proper coordination for timely project execution and compliance.
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  

* Responsible for project execution, coordination, conducting meetings, and handling

technical and commercial discussions and decisions with customers as well as the
  
internal site execution team.
  

* Develops systems and procedures for project planning, scheduling, budgeting,

billing, execution, reporting, commissioning, resource mobilization, and cost
  
control, while ensuring successful and timely execution of projects.
  

* Ensure effective project execution by implementing proper processes, systems,

and procedures while monitoring project progress and taking corrective actions
  
when required.
  

* Identify project risks, develop mitigation plans, and ensure timely execution

without cost overruns through proper planning and cost-control measures.
  

* Coordinate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, Commissioning

Engineers, vendors, contractors, customers, and internal departments for smooth
  
project execution.
  

* Maintain contractual obligations, monitor customer inputs and feedback, and

ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
  

* Manage billing targets, cash flows, invoice dispatches, and timely collection of

payments from customers.
  

* Prepare and submit MIS reports, costing reports, operational reports, billing

reports, and ensure compliance with quality standards and industry practices.
  
MEASUREABLE DELIVERABLES
  

* Timely completion of projects within approved budget and quality standards.
* Achievement of monthly billing targets and timely submission of invoices.
* Reduction in project cost overruns through effective cost-control measures.
* Timely collection of customer payments and maintenance of healthy cash flow.
* Submission of accurate MIS, costing, operational, and billing reports within defined

timelines.
  

* Improved customer satisfaction through effective coordination, issue resolution, and

compliance with contractual obligation.

KEY COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS
  

* 100% adherence to revenue targets
* Outstanding: DSO
* Cash flow (Actual Vs Budgeted)
* Cost (Actual Vs Budgeted)
* 100% Reduction in Project Man-hours
* Customer Satisfaction Index
* Timely execution of Projects - % Adherence to Schedule & contractual obligations
* MIS Reports – Within Timelines
* Project Closure – Within Timelines
* Change order intake which will increase Top line as well as bottom line
* Increase margin & maintain cash flow
* Safe & healthy work environment

CREDENTIALS & EXPERIENCE
  

* Diploma or Graduate in Instrumentation/Electrical/Electronics having 12+ years or more.
* Experience in Project Management of E&I / C&I projects.
* Engineering & Commissioning experience will be added advantage.
* Fluent in Business English, both written and spoken.

ROLE LOCATION & TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS
  

* The candidate will be based at Kolkata.
* Willingness to travel exceeds 70% of working time.
* Flexible to visit customer sites, partner locations, and industrial projects as per business

requirements.

  

We are interested in knowing you more. Start an exciting new career and enjoy many employee benefits by applying online.

Sonepar India is thankful for your interest in joining the team, only individuals selected for interview will be contacted.

More information on Sonepar India:

Website: www.soneparindia.com

title: Project Manager
description:
**Job Title:** Business Development Manager – NEET PG Classroom Programme

**Company:** Farz Auxiliar Academy Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Kolkata, West Bengal (office + field visits)  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 2-5 years

**About the Role**

Farz Academy is hiring a target-driven Business Development Manager to grow its NEET PG Classroom Coaching Programme. You will promote the programme to MBBS students (1st to 4th year), build networks with medical colleges, hospitals and educational consultancies, and convert enquiries into paid admissions.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Business Development*

* Plan and execute strategies to promote the NEET PG Classroom Programme among 1st-4th year MBBS students
* Run seminars, student meetings, awareness sessions and promotional campaigns
* Achieve monthly admission and revenue targets

*Hospital & Medical College Network*

* Regularly visit hospitals, medical colleges and institutions to connect with MBBS students, interns, doctors and institutional representatives
* Build referral networks for continuous lead generation
* Follow institutional permissions and norms for all on-campus activities

*Consultancy Partnerships*

* Visit NEET PG consultancies and admission guidance centres
* Establish new referral partnerships and explain the programme, benefits and fee structure
* Maintain regular follow-ups with partners

*Lead Generation & Conversion*

* Generate leads through institutional visits, student referrals and consultancy networks
* Coordinate with the digital marketing team on online campaigns
* Work with counsellors and telecallers to convert enquiries into admissions
* Follow up with prospective students and parents
* Monitor the full funnel, from lead to fee collection

*Programme Coordination & Reporting*

* Coordinate with the academic team on batches, schedules and batch strength
* Collect student feedback and market insights
* Submit daily field reports and weekly business development reports
* Maintain a lead database with follow-up status
* Present monthly lead, admission and revenue performance with action plans

**Indicative Monthly Targets**

* Hospital / medical college visits: 20
* Consultancy visits: 20
* New consultancy tie-ups: 4-5
* Student awareness activities: 4
* Qualified student leads: 100-150
* Paid admissions: Management-assigned target
* Revenue: Management-assigned target

Targets may be revised based on business needs, programme capacity and market conditions.

**Requirements**

* Graduate in any discipline (MBA in Marketing / Business Development preferred)
* 2-5 years of experience in education marketing, business development, institutional sales or the coaching industry
* Experience in medical education or NEET PG coaching is a plus
* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills
* Fluency in [English / Bengali / Hindi]
* Comfortable with independent field visits and monthly sales targets
* Working knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets and CRM

**How You Will Be Evaluated**

* Paid admissions and monthly revenue
* Lead-to-admission conversion ratio
* New consultancy partnerships and network growth
* Quality of reporting and follow-up

Performance is judged on actual admissions and revenue, not just the number of visits or leads.

**How to Apply**  
Send your updated CV to info@farzacademy.com with the subject line “BD Manager – NEET PG Classroom Programme”.

Pay: ₹15,166.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Head of Projects & Operations / VP – Manufacturing Operations**

**Company: Satvik Enterprises Limited**  
**Industry: Iron & Steel / Ferro Alloys Manufacturing**  
**Location: Kolkata Head Office, with frequent travel to manufacturing plants and project sites**  
**Department: Projects, Manufacturing Operations & Business Support Functions**  
**Reporting To: Managing Director / Director**  
**Position Level: Senior Leadership / Executive Management**

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**A. Project Planning and Execution**

* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and commissioning of new manufacturing projects and plant expansion initiatives.
* Develop detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and milestone-based execution strategies.
* Coordinate civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, utilities, and infrastructure activities.
* Monitor project progress against approved timelines, budgets, technical specifications, and quality standards.
* Manage contractors, consultants, EPC partners, vendors, and project management teams.
* Identify project risks, resolve execution bottlenecks, and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure timely procurement, delivery, installation, testing, and commissioning of plant machinery and equipment.
* Review engineering drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and project documentation in coordination with relevant teams.
* Ensure proper project documentation, handover, and transition from project execution to commercial operations.

**B. Manufacturing and Plant Operations**

* Lead overall manufacturing operations to achieve production, productivity, quality, cost, and delivery targets.
* Oversee ferro alloy manufacturing activities.
* Establish production planning systems, standard operating procedures, performance standards, and operational control mechanisms.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of raw materials, power, manpower, equipment, and other production resources.
* Monitor production efficiency, yield, recovery, rejection rates, downtime, and overall equipment effectiveness.
* Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance systems to improve equipment reliability and plant availability.
* Coordinate with Production, Maintenance, Quality, Logistics, Procurement, Safety, HR, and Administration teams.
* Establish daily, weekly, and monthly operational reviews to monitor performance against agreed targets.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, reduce wastage, and improve operational profitability.

**C. Operational Excellence and Cost Optimisation**

* Identify opportunities to reduce manufacturing costs, project expenditure, energy consumption, logistics costs, and operational losses.
* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for projects, production, maintenance, procurement, HR, quality, and operational efficiency.
* Implement lean manufacturing principles, process standardisation, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving techniques.
* Monitor manufacturing conversion costs, power consumption per tonne, raw material consumption, production yield, and procurement variances.
* Improve plant capacity utilisation and equipment performance through systematic operational reviews.
* Develop dashboards and management reports highlighting operational performance, cost variances, risks, and corrective actions.
* Drive cross-functional coordination to improve working capital utilisation, inventory management, and overall business efficiency.

**D. Technical and Engineering Management**

* Review technical feasibility, plant layout, equipment selection, engineering design, and process requirements.
* Ensure coordination between engineering, production, maintenance, electrical, instrumentation, and utility functions.
* Oversee installation and commissioning of furnaces, material handling systems, pollution control equipment, electrical systems, and associated plant infrastructure.
* Ensure equipment specifications and operating parameters meet approved technical and production requirements.
* Support troubleshooting of critical technical issues and implement sustainable corrective measures.
* Coordinate with technical consultants, equipment suppliers, and engineering partners to ensure reliable plant performance.

**E. Procurement and Strategic Sourcing**

* Develop and implement procurement strategies for raw materials, plant machinery, equipment, spares, consumables, services, and project materials.
* Lead strategic sourcing initiatives to ensure competitive pricing, quality, timely delivery, and reliable supply.
* Establish and maintain an effective vendor development, evaluation, empanelment, and performance monitoring system.
* Review technical and commercial proposals and recommend vendors based on quality, cost, delivery, service, and commercial terms.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, credit periods, delivery schedules, and contractual conditions in accordance with company policies.
* Coordinate with Production, Projects, Finance, Stores, and Logistics to ensure uninterrupted availability of critical materials.
* Monitor purchase orders, supplier commitments, delivery schedules, inventory levels, and procurement budgets.
* Develop procurement controls to minimise emergency purchases, excess inventory, material shortages, and avoidable costs.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, purchase approvals, contract management, and compliance with internal procurement procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance for vendor payments, advances, outstanding balances, and reconciliation of commercial transactions.

**F. HR Operations and Administration**

* Oversee HR operations in coordination with the HR Head and the Administration function, ensuring alignment with the company's business and manpower requirements.
* Drive manpower planning, workforce budgeting, recruitment priorities, and deployment of personnel across the Head Office, manufacturing plants, and project sites.
* Monitor compliance with applicable labour laws, factory-related employment requirements, minimum wages, contract labour regulations, and other statutory obligations.
* Oversee industrial relations, contractor workforce management, grievance handling, disciplinary processes, and employee engagement in coordination with HR.
* Review workforce productivity, absenteeism, attrition, overtime, manpower costs, and staffing efficiency.
* Ensure implementation of HR policies, code of conduct, performance management, training, and employee development initiatives**.**

**G. Quality, Safety and Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to product quality standards, process specifications, and customer requirements.
* Establish and monitor quality control systems and corrective and preventive action plans.
* Promote a strong safety culture across projects, plant operations, and contractor activities.

**H. Logistics, Supply Chain and Inventory Management**

* Oversee coordination of inbound and outbound logistics for raw materials, machinery, spares, and finished products.
* Monitor inventory levels, stock ageing, material availability, and working capital tied up in inventory.
* Coordinate with Sales, Procurement, Production, Finance, and Logistics teams to meet customer delivery commitments.
* Monitor logistics KPIs, freight expenditure, transit losses, delivery performance, and supply chain risks.
* Develop international sourcing strategies and identify suitable overseas suppliers, trading partners, and logistics service providers.
* Monitor shipment schedules, lead times, documentation accuracy, and delivery commitments to minimise delays and additional costs.
* Evaluate international supplier performance, commercial risks, foreign exchange exposure, and supply chain disruptions.
* Maintain proper import/export records and coordinate with Finance for reconciliation, duty benefits, export incentives, and applicable regulatory reporting.
* Ensure that import and export transactions are executed within approved commercial, financial, and compliance frameworks.

**I. Leadership and Stakeholder Management**

* Lead and mentor project managers, plant heads, engineering teams, production teams, procurement personnel, HR teams, and other functional leaders.
* Establish accountability, performance standards, reporting mechanisms, and review systems across departments.
* Coordinate with senior management on strategic planning, capital expenditure, project priorities, procurement strategies, international trade, manpower planning, and operational challenges.
* Prepare and present periodic reports on project status, production performance, procurement costs, import/export transactions, workforce performance, budget utilisation, and business outcomes.
* Build a performance-driven culture focused on safety, quality, cost efficiency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure effective communication and coordination between the Head Office, project sites, manufacturing plants, suppliers, customers, and external stakeholders.
* Support business expansion initiatives, capacity enhancement, operational restructuring, and long-term organisational development.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Performance will be assessed against the following parameters:**

* **Timely completion of projects and achievement of commissioning milestones.**
* **Adherence to approved project budgets and control of cost overruns.**
* **Achievement of production targets, plant capacity utilisation, and equipment availability.**
* **Improvement in production yield, recovery, product quality, and manufacturing efficiency.**
* **Reduction in power consumption, manufacturing cost, wastage, downtime, and operational losses.**
* **Procurement cost savings, supplier performance, material availability, and purchase cycle time.**
* **Timely execution of import and export shipments, customs clearance, and trade documentation.**
* **Control of international freight, demurrage, detention, and other avoidable trade-related costs.**
* **Compliance with import/export regulations and timely realisation or settlement of trade transactions, as applicable.**
* **Manpower productivity, recruitment turnaround time, attendance management, and workforce cost optimisation.**
* **Compliance with HR policies, labour laws, contractor requirements, and statutory obligations.**
* **Improvement in inventory turnover, logistics efficiency, and working capital utilisation.**
* **Compliance with safety, environmental, quality, and other statutory requirements.**
* **Timely resolution of project, manufacturing, procurement, HR, and supply chain bottlenecks.**
* **Achievement of profitability, productivity, and overall operational excellence objectives.**

**Educational Qualifications**

* **Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.**
* **Master's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Project Management, Supply Chain Management, or Business Administration will be an added advantage.**
* **Additional qualifications or professional certifications in project management, international trade, supply chain management, procurement, lean manufacturing, or operations excellence will be preferred.**

**Experience and Industry Exposure**

* **Typically 15–20+ years of relevant professional experience in industrial project execution, plant commissioning, manufacturing operations, procurement, supply chain management, and cross-functional leadership.**
* **Experience in senior leadership roles managing multiple functions, operational budgets, project teams, and plant performance will be strongly preferred.**
* **Practical exposure to import/export operations, international procurement, customs clearance, trade documentation, shipping, and commercial banking processes will be advantageous.**
* **Experience in HR operations, workforce planning, industrial relations, contractor management, and labour compliance in manufacturing environments will be preferred.**
* **Experience in iron and steel, ferro alloys, metals, heavy engineering, or other process manufacturing industries will be strongly preferred.**
* **Experience in greenfield projects, brownfield expansion, furnace-based manufacturing, and plant commissioning will be particularly valuable.**

**Working Hours:** 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM

**Job Summary**

Centreax Technologies is looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead end-to-end technology projects, manage cross-functional teams, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge across multiple technologies, excellent client-handling (both Domestic and International) and English communication skills, and the ability to coordinate development, testing, and deployment activities while ensuring project objectives are met.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the complete project lifecycle, including planning, estimation, execution, monitoring, delivery, and closure.
* Coordinate development, testing, and technical teams to ensure timely delivery and quality standards.
* Manage client communication, stakeholder expectations, project reviews, and escalations.
* Use Jira to track project progress, tasks, milestones, risks, and deliverables.
* Work closely with technical leads and architects to address technical challenges and integration requirements.
* Prepare project plans, status reports, technical documentation, and management updates.
* Monitor project timelines, budgets, resource allocation, and overall delivery performance.
* Identify project risks and implement corrective actions to ensure successful delivery.
* Follow Agile/Scrum practices and drive continuous improvement in project execution.

**Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 12–15 years of professional experience in IT project management, software development, or technology delivery.
* Must hold a valid PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum project management certification.
* Strong knowledge of multiple technologies, software development methodologies, application architecture, APIs, and system integration.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions, with the ability to coordinate AI-driven projects and collaborate with technical teams on AI-based application development and implementation.
* Hands-on experience with Jira and practical knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Experience coordinating software development, QA/testing, defect management, deployment, and post-implementation support.
* Strong understanding of project planning, estimation, budgeting, resource management, risk mitigation, and delivery governance.
* Excellent English communication, leadership, domestic and international client-handling, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to prepare and review project plans, requirement documents, technical specifications, and status reports.
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams, handle multiple priorities, and deliver projects within agreed timelines and quality standards.

**Candidates with strong technical architecture knowledge, excellent client-handling skills, and proven experience in managing software development and testing teams will be preferred.**
